title: Cavity-Enhanced Collective Quantum Processing with Polarization-Encoded Qubits
abstract: arXiv:2605.10473v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We introduce a cavity-enhanced optical architecture for collective quantum processing in which logical qubits are encoded in the polarization subspace of recirculating intracavity modes. The physical carrier and computational degree of freedom are explicitly separated: harmonic cavity bundles provide a stable resonant substrate, while programmable polarization transformations implement single-qubit operations. A polarization-selective nonlinear interaction in the entanglement region generates tunable controlled-phase gates, enabling a universal gate set. A parameter-scaling analysis shows that order-unity conditional phases are attainable in centimeter-scale cavities using experimentally accessible solid-state nonlinear media, without requiring extreme nonlinear coefficients, millisecond photon lifetimes, or sub-hertz laser stabilization. The results indicate that resonant recirculation provides a physically plausible platform

translated_title: 基于偏振编码量子比特的腔增强集体量子处理
translated_abstract: 我们提出了一种腔增强的光学架构，用于集体量子处理，其中逻辑量子比特编码在循环腔内模式的偏振子空间中。物理载体与计算自由度被明确分离：谐波腔束提供稳定的共振基底，而可编程的偏振变换实现单量子比特操作。纠缠区域中的偏振选择性非线性相互作用产生可调谐的控制相位门，从而构成通用门集。参数缩放分析表明，在使用实验上可行的固态非线性介质、厘米级腔体中，无需极端非线性系数、毫秒级光子寿命或亚赫兹激光稳定，即可实现阶数为一的条件相位。结果表明，共振循环提供了一个物理上可行的平台。
tldr: 本文提出一种腔增强光学架构，通过分离物理载体和计算自由度，在厘米级腔体中实现偏振编码量子比特的通用量子处理，无需极端条件。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a cavity-enhanced optical architecture that separates physical carriers from computational degrees of freedom, enabling universal quantum processing with polarization-encoded qubits in centimeter-scale cavities without extreme requirements.
